question: If cos 2 theta = (1)/(2) then the value of sin (75° - θ ) will be:
solution:

cos2theta=(1)/(2)

**Concept Used:**

cos2theta=1-2sin²theta

sin² theta + cos² theta=1

sin(A + B) = sinA times cosB + cosA times sinB

cos(A + B) = cosA times cosB – sinA times sinB

**Calculation:**

⇒ Using the formula,

⇒ 1-2sin²theta=(1)/(2)
